body:
1. In `lib/scheduler.mjs`: include `...(activeRailsNow.rails ?? [])` in `cfRails` before `checkCounterFile()` at line 2068; replace raw `execFileSync('git', ['cat-file', '-e', ...])` at line 781 with `g(repo, 'cat-file', '-e', `${baseRefSha}:${p}`)`; also add `.git` to `test/scheduler.test.mjs` `initRepo` / verify fixture.
2. In `lib/review.mjs`: remove raw `console.error('LENS ERRORS DETECTED:', ...)` at line 164.
3. In `sidecars/app.js`: wrap `${data.warning}` in `${escapeHtml(data.warning)}` at line 71.
4. In `sidecars/server.mjs`: scan forward in 64 KiB chunks when `lastNewline === -1` and `offset + toRead < stats.size` so `newOffset` advances past the entire oversized line on the first poll.
5. In `scripts/stage-marketplace-plugin.mjs`: add `'commands'` to `MARKETPLACE_RUNTIME_PATHS`.
6. In `scripts/check-bundle-externals.mjs`: add `'vendor/adlc/dist/watchdog.mjs'` to `DEFAULT_BUNDLES` and detect `process.(binding|_linkedBinding|dlopen)` in `scanSource()`.
7. In `scripts/update-adlc-digests.mjs`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, and `.github/workflows/publish.yml`: reject `--write` + `--skip-registry`, check all 9 `VENDORED_PACKAGES` in `--skip-registry` mode, resolve Issue #136 in `ci.yml`, and enforce `plugin.json === package.json` version lockstep + `node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs --check`.
title: Fix scheduler counter-file rails & git cat-file wrapper, review console noise, sidecar warning XSS & oversized line skip, marketplace commands staging, bundle externals watchdog, and CI/digest checks
